method.full_resolution_review: Each frozen 1080x1080 master PNG was inspected at original resolution.
method.standard_preview_review: All candidates were compared at 360x360 after Lanczos downsampling.
method.stress_preview_review: Each master was downsampled directly to 120x120 with Lanczos. The six thumbnails were enlarged 3x with nearest-neighbor only for pixel-preserving inspection.
limitations: The 120-pixel derivative is a stress test, not a claim about an Instagram delivery transform.
This audit measures visual survival and layout integrity, not clicks, conversion, recall, or an externally controlled winner.
Mandatory state recovery prevents a generator-blind or candidate-blind critic claim.

decision.candidate_d_reason: The stress test confirms its existing text-hook distinction but supplies no delivery or outcome evidence strong enough to justify a near-duplicate iteration and seventh queue event.
decision.next_action: Reconcile local queue and receipt evidence without polling. Activate the blocked real-photo packet only if authorized source-metadata-bearing media appears. Bind exact external feedback before changing the non-dominated strategy set or spending another same-Brief image call.
